text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The supreme court has thrown out an application by opposition parties questioning President Frederick Chiluba's use of one of his forenames which they say is not on his registration card.

- Jailed Post newspaper editor Masautso Phiri has raised a storm in the Supreme Court by demanding that three judges he claims are biased be recused from hearing his appeal against a three-month prison sentence for contempt of court.
- Zambia is now the third largest exporter of floriculture products to Europe from the African Caribbean Pacific (ACP) grouping.
- The farmers union has commended government for undertaking to fund cooperatives.
